subject.title: fix(plugins): run message_sending on all channel agent-reply deliveries (#92374)

question: Should Telegram keep a delivery-owned `message_sending` opt-out once the suffix re-entry defect is fixed, or should this work be split into a narrower dispatcher-only fix first?
rationale: The implementation direction crosses the shared plugin safety-hook boundary and Telegram streaming ownership; the code defect is clear, but the permanent hook ownership boundary is a maintainer merge-risk choice.

options.title: Keep Comprehensive Fix After Repair
options.body: Repair suffix delivery so already-gated chunks do not re-enter `message_sending`, then use this PR as the canonical fix for the dispatcher and streamed-final gaps.

options.title: Land Dispatcher-Only First
options.body: Use a narrower branch such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 for the configured `beforeDeliver` bypass and leave streamed-final coverage on the canonical issue.

options.title: Redesign The Hook Boundary
options.body: Pause this PR and design a shared per-message outbound hook seam instead of adding a Telegram-owned dispatcher opt-out.

recommendation.title: Keep Comprehensive Fix After Repair
recommendation.body: Repair suffix delivery so already-gated chunks do not re-enter `message_sending`, then use this PR as the canonical fix for the dispatcher and streamed-final gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved defect is in Telegram streamed lane delivery and long-message continuation handling, where recent history points to this owner area.
